title: CONVOCATION CEREMONY
message:
OFFICIAL NOTICE: 42ND ANNUAL CONVOCATION CEREMONY

Date of Event: November 15, 2026

Venue: Main Campus Auditorium

Reporting Time: 09:00 AM IST
Registration & Fee Details

    Online Registration Window: October 1, 2026 – October 25, 2026

    Convocation Fee: ₹1,500 (Includes Degree Certificate & Gown Rental)

    Mode of Attendance: In-Person / In-Absentia (Postal Delivery)

Eligibility

    All undergraduate and postgraduate students who successfully completed their degree requirements in the 2025–2026 academic year.

    No pending dues (Library, Hostel, or Administrative clearances required).
